profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap point, tagged telecom=data_center, is named "Factory Software | AVEVA Select Italia." AVEVA is a real, publicly traded industrial software company, listed on the London Stock Exchange, that provides engineering design, operations management, and asset-performance software used across manufacturing, energy, and process industries worldwide. "AVEVA Select" is the branding AVEVA uses for its network of regional reseller and systems-integrator partners, and this record most plausibly identifies an Italian partner office selling and supporting AVEVA's software products under that program, likely operating under the name "Factory Software" as the local reseller entity. A software reseller and integrator's office maintains its own business IT systems but is not a data-center operator; the telecom=data_center tag here is best read as a mistag of the office's own server or IT closet.

reading.body:
This record is a mistagged software office, not a data center, and it carries zero megawatts of load.

The point sits in Italy near Milan Malpensa airport and is tagged telecom=data_center in OpenStreetMap. The name resolves to an Italian reseller office for AVEVA, an industrial software company, operating under its regional partner branding. A reseller's office runs its own business IT, which is the likely source of the tag, but it does not operate a data center.

For AI specifically, the distinction matters because facility counts are often used as a proxy for compute capacity. A point like this adds one to a tally of data centers while contributing no power, no cooling, and no servers available to anyone. The zero megawatts in the record is the honest number here, and it is the number that matters.

What this does not tell the reader is how many other points in the same dataset are mistagged the same way. One corrected record says nothing about the error rate of the whole set. It also says nothing about actual data center capacity in Italy, since a single mislabeled office is not evidence about the facilities that are real.
